result.summary: Lantern Services has sent a £75.11 invoice (event 024), but nothing on file shows the work was done. The day before, on 27 Feb, the contractor (Harper) was still calling the tenant to arrange a visit (event 022). The invoice document isn't on the job either. So I haven't forwarded it to the landlord or moved the job to close-out. I've asked Lantern Services what happened at the visit and for the invoice PDF, asked the tenant whether the engineer has been, and put the job on hold with a follow-up in 2 days.

judgement.why_this_decision: The landlord approved an engineer visit with no cost cap (event 008, approval 55, no amount). An invoice can only go to the landlord once the work is confirmed. Here the records point the other way: the visit slot of 23/02 15:25 (event 017) is earlier than the scheduling calls that evening (events 015–016). On 26 Feb the system flagged that no work results had come back (event 020). On 27 Feb the contractor was still asking to schedule (event 022). Following lessons #19 and #32, I'm not assuming the work was done and am chasing the contractor for the outcome. Lesson #18 (treating the invoice note as the completion record) doesn't fit, because the invoice email describes no findings, fix or test. Lesson #3 (forward the invoice and close) assumes the job is complete, which isn't confirmed here.

alternatives_considered.option: Forward the invoice to the landlord and move to close-out (lesson #3)
alternatives_considered.why_not: Nothing confirms the work was done, the invoice document isn't on the job, and event 022 suggests the visit may not have happened yet.
The contractor and tenant can settle this between them. The amount is small and the attendance was approved. Escalate only if the replies conflict or don't come.

alternatives_considered.option: Do nothing / return to auto mode (lesson #1)
alternatives_considered.why_not: An invoice is waiting with no completion record, so someone has to chase actively.

The 'Tuesday 1pm' in event 016 is the actual planned visit (27 Feb), not the 23/02 slot in event 017

result.situation: Routine washing machine repair (not heating on 60°C cycles). The landlord approved an engineer and Lantern Services was assigned. The ticket is in works. An invoice notification for £75.11 has arrived with no completion report, and the contractor's call on 27 Feb suggests the visit may not have happened.

actions_taken.description: Loaded the ticket, profiles, events and approvals
actions_taken.result: Approval 55 approved (no amount); no attachments; no open holds; duplicate ticket R/PM042-1 open

actions_taken.description: Looked up how the team handled invoices that arrive without completion reports
actions_taken.result: Lessons #19 and #32 followed (chase the contractor for the outcome); #3 and #18 not applicable

actions_taken.description: Emailed Lantern Services asking for the attendance date, findings and work done, whether more work is needed, and the invoice PDF with the job reference
Emailed the tenant asking whether the engineer has visited and the machine now heats; said we'll update by 1 March
Put the job on hold waiting on the contractor, follow-up in 2 days
Recorded that the contractor invoiced before any completion report

escalation.reason: The contractor and tenant can resolve this; no disputed amount yet
escalation.recommendation: Escalate if the contractor and tenant give conflicting accounts, if the invoice turns out to be for unperformed work, or if there's no reply by the follow-up.
